title.narrative: Chandigarh 24/7 Water Supply Project

description.narrative: The overall objective is to improve the water supply quality of service in Chandigarh, accompanying the infrastructural and organisational changes required to provide 24x7 water supply to the entire city from surface water sources in an efficient and sustainable manner.
